title: VeloraOS 1.10.38 - Chat Delivery Reliability Hotfix
releaseNotes: Fixes completed model responses occasionally disappearing instead of being appended to Chat.
Uses stable per-user-turn IDs and per-background-task assistant IDs instead of fragile whole-conversation equality checks.
Retains edit/resend safety by rejecting late responses after a newer user turn or an existing assistant answer.
Adds browser-side recovery from the completed background task payload if a harmless persistence race occurs.
Clears stale working banners when generation completes and prevents duplicate recovered replies.
Preserves Qwen2.5 3B, Coding mode, adaptive budgets, Ollama watchdogs, automatic continuation and hidden-reasoning protection.
